authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Coach is driving growth and margin while Kate Spade loses money; the USD2bn return plan depends on Coach sustaining full-year cash generation without sacrificing flexibility.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share and percentages

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories, the JSON inventory and actual wealth content; Tapestry has a maintained stock profile but no Coach-versus-Kate-Spade capital-allocation analysis.
Checked recent publication records, live content, and open and merged PRs; no matching Tapestry story or fingerprint was active or published.
Checked the 8 November Europe/Dublin publication ledger before drafting; all three scheduled slots were open and no active company-publication attempt existed.
Routine quarterly figures remain on /stocks/tpr/; the article addresses brand concentration, turnaround economics and capital returns.
candidate_review_reference: See b891b944ced9fbc6d64ed364.json for the ten-company screen; Tapestry was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Q1 sales were USD1.894bn, up 11%; pro-forma growth excluding prior-year Stuart Weitzman was 12%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release overview and Form 10-Q net-sales discussion.
evidence_table.result: verified; reported and pro-forma measures separated

evidence_table.claim: Coach sales were USD1.661bn, up 16.1%, and operating income USD590m with 35.5% margin.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Form 10-Q brand tables; 1,661 / 1,894 = 87.7% of group sales.
evidence_table.result: verified and calculated share independently recomputed

evidence_table.claim: Kate Spade sales were USD233m, down 10.4%, and GAAP operating loss was USD20m with negative 8.7% margin; non-GAAP loss was USD6m.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Form 10-Q brand tables and comparability discussion.
evidence_table.result: verified; GAAP and non-GAAP losses separated

evidence_table.claim: Non-GAAP gross margin was 78.7%, up 220 basis points, including about 130 operational, 70 tariff/duty and 20 FX basis points.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release gross-margin bridge and Form 10-Q MD&A.

evidence_table.claim: First-quarter operating cash was USD197m and adjusted free cash flow USD56m; cash and short-term investments were USD782m and borrowings USD2.56bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release balance-sheet and cash-flow highlights; free cash flow identified as adjusted.

evidence_table.claim: Management targets about USD2.0bn of fiscal-year capital returns, including USD1.7bn of buybacks, and adjusted free cash flow approaching USD1.7bn.
evidence_table.result: verified and labelled as management guidance

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, fiscal date, brand, accounting measure, management explanation, guidance item and calculation was reread against the release and Form 10-Q; seasonal first-quarter cash was not presented as full-year funding.
